structures.questionTemplate:
Express as a single fraction in its simplest form:

$$${scope.expr}$$
steps: 1) Factorise denominator: ${scope.s1}
2) Identify lowest common denominator among the terms: ${scope.s2}
3) Manipulate each term to have the lowest common denominator: $$${scope.s3}$$
4) Add/subtract the numerator, divided by the LCD: $$${scope.s4}$$
5) Simplify the numerator: $$${scope.ans}$$

derived.expr: scope.firstIsQuad === 1 ? '\\frac{' + scope.a + '}{' + scope.quad + '} ' + scope.op + ' \\frac{' + scope.b + '}{' + scope.lin + '}' : '\\frac{' + scope.a + '}{' + scope.lin + '} ' + scope.op + ' \\frac{' + scope.b + '}{' + scope.quad + '}'
derived.s3: scope.firstIsQuad === 1 ? '\\frac{' + scope.a + '}{(' + scope.lin + ')^2} ' + scope.op + ' \\frac{' + scope.b + '(' + scope.lin + ')}{(' + scope.lin + ')^2}' : '\\frac{' + scope.a + '(' + scope.lin + ')}{(' + scope.lin + ')^2} ' + scope.op + ' \\frac{' + scope.b + '}{(' + scope.lin + ')^2}'
derived.s4: scope.firstIsQuad === 1 ? '\\frac{' + scope.a + ' ' + scope.op + ' ' + scope.b + '(' + scope.lin + ')}{(' + scope.lin + ')^2}' : '\\frac{' + scope.a + '(' + scope.lin + ') ' + scope.op + ' ' + scope.b + '}{(' + scope.lin + ')^2}'
derived.numSimp: (function(){ var a=scope.a, b=scope.b, k=scope.k, isAdd=scope.isAdd===1, isMinus=scope.isMinusBin===1, fQuad=scope.firstIsQuad===1; if(fQuad){ if(isAdd){ var c = isMinus ? a - b*k : a + b*k; return b + 'x' + (c >= 0 ? ' + ' + c : ' - ' + Math.abs(c)); } else { var c = isMinus ? a + b*k : a - b*k; return '-' + b + 'x' + (c >= 0 ? ' + ' + c : ' - ' + Math.abs(c)); } } else { if(isAdd){ var c = isMinus ? -a*k + b : a*k + b; return a + 'x' + (c >= 0 ? ' + ' + c : ' - ' + Math.abs(c)); } else { var c = isMinus ? -a*k - b : a*k - b; return a + 'x' + (c >= 0 ? ' + ' + c : ' - ' + Math.abs(c)); } } })()
